comment: Very hard class but he sets you up for success if you put in the time. One of the more considerate professors I've had–cares about all of his students dearly and puts in the time to help them and give them the feedback they need. By far my fav course at richmond. You must take it with bhakta if you can.

We love Bhakta. The class is hard plain and simple, but he does his best to articulate concepts to his students and truly wants the best for them. Very often available for extra help and gives opportunities for test makeups. Will do whatever it takes for you to understand a topic if you show him you want to understand it without holding your hand🐐

Dr. Bhakta is the most accessible professor outside of class. When you ask a question he does not just brush you off but will literally explain it a thousand times until you understand. The classes he teaches are hard, but you are left with extremely good understanding of the subject afterwards. Tough but great professor!

Great professor, although the material itself is difficult, Bhakta is not. He explains things thoroughly and always offers extensive time outside of class to students. One of the harder classes I've taken, but loved it and would recommend Bhakta

Most accessible cs professor outside of class in UR. Make sure you have enough time for office hours. Just take his course, because he made algorithms easy to understand. Moreover, what he taught also helps me better performing in technical interviews.
He is literally the most accessible and helpful professor in the UR. Just take him and you'll know algorithms very well!

Great professor, really accessible outside of class. Tests were very similar to the homework. Lots of work and it takes a lot of time to get it done but I did not find the work particularly hard compared to other CS classes. He does a good job in lectures explaining the subjects. Most of the work I felt was needed its not just busy work

Dr. Bhakta is most accessible professor outside of class that I have had here at UR so far. He is knowledgeable about the subject matter and cares about his students. He spends a lot of class time letting students think about and solve problems. This semester he often has waited a few minutes before starting class to let students trickle in.
Put attention to lectures and go to office hours. Great class for beginners, materials are organized step by step with clear targets.

Dr. Bhakta is a great teacher who knows his stuff very well. He is good at explaining the material and always provides room for extra credit. If you know what you're doing you will do well in the class, but if you struggle with the material then it will show in your grade as his tests are definitely challenging. Not an easy A but will learn a lot!

He's great. Algorithms can be hard, but Dr. Bhakta does a great job with it. I feel like if you can keep up with it (and even if you can't), his lectures are awesome and engaging. I feel like everything is fair, though the course is very polarizing: either you're A-B or you're sub-50 at all times. Still, 10/10, would recommend and take anytime :)

Cannot go wrong with Dr Bhakta. Will lecture with no notes whatsoever---he's a master of this topic. Will make sure you understand the topic well before moving on. If you just go to all the lectures and office hours you cannot do bad in this class.

He is literally my favorite professor in the entire department. His lecture is always so well organized that everything flows. You could tell he really enjoys teaching and cares about students. He is incredibly smart, helpful, and SUPER chill. His office is always full with students. I already decided whichever class he teaches I'll go take it.
Professor Bhakta is a real gem.
Super smart man. Funnest class I've taken so far. You must think.

He is one of the best! His lecture is so engaging and obviously he knows what he is teaching. The homework problems are pretty hard and often you need to go to his office hour to get everything done. His office hour is always pretty crowded. His tests are really hard but the whole course is fair if you actually get this stuff.

Dr. Bhakta is brilliant!! So brilliant that maybe he should stay with the brilliant students. If you have no prior knowledge on computer science, this class is hell!!! If you do, it may be easy A. Also, he never returned back any lab assignments or hw, so I had no clue what grade I was going o get!

One of my favorite professors! His lectures are engaging and easy to understand. The course was challenging, but he's helpful and always available to students.  Dr. Bhakta is outrageously smart, knows his materials very well, (plus brilliant at board games), but he's far from condescending/intimidating. Very chill and can connect well to students.

Take him if you can. He has office hours almost everyday, and they're very helpful. Also, everything feels fair. All the resources necessary to get good grades are available to you. Labs and assignments are really easy to get 100 on, but tests are pretty hard. He also grades on a curve, but he never curves down. It will only help your grade.
